source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: In a Dominatus event, each player is paired against someone from a different Alliance. Beyond that, and beyond matching players with equal records, Games Workshop’s official events mostly follow the recommendations below, aimed at the fairest, most enjoyable games for every attendee whatever their standing.

detail.dominatusRule: each player is paired with a player from another Alliance
detail.baseline: pair players with the same record
detail.recommendations: followed at most official Games Workshop events
aim: most fun experience for every attendee regardless of standing
